scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run open:browser"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && npm install && npm run dev:backend
scripts.dev:frontend: cd frontend/docs && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run dev
scripts.open:browser: sleep 5 && (google-chrome http://localhost:5173 2>/dev/null || chromium-browser http://localhost:5173 2>/dev/null || xdg-open http://localhost:5173)
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend/docs && npm install && npm run build
scripts.start: npm run build && cd backend && npm start
